title: CWP/14077/2025 of VIKAS GUPTA BERIWAL Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND ANOTHER
text:
2025°PHHC 065829 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 129 CWP No.14047 of 2025 DATE OF DECISION : 16" MAY, 2025 Vikas Gupta Beriwal .... Petitioner Versus State of Haryana & another .... Respondents CORAM : HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP TIWARI 2K Ook Ok Ok Present: | Mr. Chanderhas Yadav, Advocate for the petitioner. KOK OK OK KULDEEP TIWARI, J. (Oral)

1. Through the instant writ petition filed under Articles 226/227 of the Constitution of India, a prayer is made for issuance of a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent No.2 to take appropriate action against illegal members in the Society, as per the complaint dated 25.02.2025 (Annexure P-11), and _ furthermore, directions to conduct election of the Society, in a fair and transparent manner, which are due w.e.f. 2019 (Annexure P-1) .

2. The counsel for the petitioner submits that despite issuance of ‘show cause notice’ to respondent No.2, for not conducting elections of the society concerned, till date no further action has been taken. This lackadaisical and indolent approach of respondent No.2, propelled the petitioner to approach this court for seeking mandamus upon respondent No.2.

3. Notice of motion. RAJ KUMAR I /judgment CWP No.14047 of 2025 2025:PHHC 065829 § -24. Mr. Rajesh Gaur, Addl. A.G., Haryana accepts notice on behalf of respondents, and waives service.

5. At this stage, this court is of the considered opinion that the instant petition can be disposed of by issuing a mandamus upon respondent No.2, to take a final decision upon the show cause notice (Annexure P-8), within two months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order. It is expected that the aforesaid exercise be concluded after giving an adequate opportunity of hearing to the parties concerned.

6. Disposed of accordingly. 16" May, 2025 ( KULDEEP TIWARI ) ‘raj’ JUDGE I /judgment
